description: A single function generator that is also a slew limiter and an envelope follower, with a freeze input and both a positive and an inverted output

params.text: Latches the channel into free running, so it retriggers itself the moment the fall ends; the lamp beside it is lit while looping
Sets how long the rise takes, from a tenth of a millisecond at the far left to 1500 seconds at the far right
Sets how long the fall takes, from a tenth of a millisecond at the far left to 1500 seconds at the far right
Bends both slopes: logarithmic at the far left, linear a third of the way up, exponential at the far right; the left half also stretches the stage times, the right half shortens them
Sets the peak the generated function reaches, from 0V to 10V, and starts at 8V; a signal being slewed passes at full level whatever this knob says

inputs.text: A signal to slew; while no cycle is running the output tracks this voltage at the rates set by SURGE and SINK, and while a cycle is running the signal is folded into it gently instead
A rising edge above 1V starts a fresh rise; an edge during the rise is ignored, one during the fall drops the output to 0V and restarts, and all of them are ignored while HALT is high
A voltage above 2.5V freezes the module: the output, both gates and the position in the cycle are held where they were, and triggers and looping are ignored until it falls back below 2.5V
Lengthens the rise by half an octave of time per volt, and shortens it for negative voltage, over a span of twelve octaves either way
Scales the rise and the fall together, positive voltage making the whole cycle faster and negative voltage slower
Lengthens the fall by half an octave of time per volt, and shortens it for negative voltage, over a span of twelve octaves either way

outputs.text: A 10V gate that goes high at the top of the rise and stays high for the whole of the fall; with a signal patched into INPUT and no cycle running it is high while the slew falls
A 10V gate that is high for the whole of the rise; with a signal patched into INPUT and no cycle running it is high while the slew rises
The generated function, or the slewed input signal, running upward from 0V
The same voltage as OUT+ with its sign flipped, so it runs downward from 0V

notes: with nothing patched into INPUT or TRIG and LOOP off, the module holds at 0V; it needs a trigger, a loop or a patched signal before it puts anything out
the dark rectangle draws the shape of the cycle, with a dot running along it while the channel is active; nothing on it can be clicked or dragged
menu: Bandlimited EOR/EOC — smooths the edges of the EoR and EoC gates so they alias less at audio rates
Bandlimited Signal Outputs — smooths the jump the generator makes when a fall reaches the bottom, so the output aliases less at audio rates
Preview Tracer — draws a moving dot on the curve display showing where the channel is in its cycle
Interpolate Timing Updates — spreads a change of rise or fall time across the samples between timing updates, removing the zipper tone heavy modulation otherwise causes
Timing Update Rate — sets how often the rise and fall times are recalculated from the knobs and the CV, at audio rate or one sample in four, eight, sixteen or thirty-two

inputs.1:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
